event_scan_aborted.doc: Event for when a (deep)scan is aborted (requires attribute scanner and/or scanned) (object = scanner if supplied, otherwise scanned, param = the other object, param2 = true iff object is scanner)

scanner.doc: Object which performs the scanning, or group of objects (attribute must be present if scanned not supplied)

event_scan_started.name: event_scan_started
event_scan_started.doc: Event for when a (deep)scan is started (requires attribute scanner and/or scanned) (object = scanner if supplied, otherwise scanned, param = the other object, param2 = true iff object is scanner)

scanned.doc: Object which is scanned, or group of objects (attribute must be present if scanner not supplied)

scanner.doc: Object which performs the scanning, or group of objects (attribute must be present if scanned not supplied)

event_sector_resource_depleted.name: event_sector_resource_depleted
event_sector_resource_depleted.doc: Event for a resource in sector being depleted by a certain amount (object = sector, param = resource ware, param2 = depletion amount, param3 = [sector position, killed object, was depleted by player owned])

check.doc: Produce an error message if the provided event object does not exist? Default is true. event_space_reservation_expired.name: event_space_reservation_expired
event_space_reservation_expired.doc: Event for when a space reservation is expired (object = reserving component, param = zone that the reservation was stored on, param2 = reservation index)

event_speak_finished.name: event_speak_finished
event_speak_finished.doc: Event for when an actor has finished speaking (object = actor, param = page, param2 = line, param3 = interrupted - 0 if fully finished, 1 if interrupted, 2 if not even started). NOTE: The page and line parameters match the text entry that was passed to the speak system before resolving any text references. The event is fired even if the speak fails due to priority being too low or if it is interrupted. In case of a sequence of multiple text entries, page and line match the first provided page/line pair, not the last one.

line.doc: Line ID in a text page

event_speak_line_finished.name: event_speak_line_finished
event_speak_line_finished.doc: Event for when an actor has finished speaking a single text line, possibly a part of a speech with multiple lines (object = actor, param = page, param2 = line). NOTE: Unlike <event_speak_finished>, this event requires the actor to be specified, and the parameters page and line match the exact spoken text entry after the resolution of text references. WARNING: The event is not fired if the speech cannot start or if it gets interrupted before the end of the line, so it is unreliable. If this event is necessary to wait for a specific line within a multi-line speech, handle those cases by combining with other events in a <check_any> block, e.g. with <event_speak_finished> using the first provided page/line pair (see documentation). Otherwise, this event is not needed and should not be used (use <event_speak_finished> instead).

check.doc: Produce an error message if the provided event object does not exist? Default is true. NOTE: If the event object is a variable or a changeable property, changing it at a later time has no direct effect on this event condition, i.e. it is not re-enabled automatically. It is only updated under certain conditions, e.g. when loading a savegame or when the event condition is restarted explicitly (resetting MD cue or starting AI script).

line.doc: Line ID in a text page

event_speak_timer_triggered.name: event_speak_timer_triggered
event_speak_timer_triggered.doc: Event for when a speak timer was triggered in a <speak> or <add_npc_line> via the timer attribute (object = actor, param = page, param2 = line, param3 = interrupted - 0 if speak is continuing after the event, 1 if interrupted, 2 if not even started). NOTE: The page and line parameters match the text entry that was passed to the speak system before resolving any text references. The event is fired even if the speak fails due to priority being too low or if it is interrupted before the trigger time. In case of a sequence of multiple text entries, only one text entry may specify a timer event. The page and line parameters of the event match the first provided page/line pair, not necessarily the one which defines the timer.

line.doc: Line ID in a text page

event_supplies_added.name: event_supplies_added
event_supplies_added.doc: Event for when supply wares were added to container object (object = container, param = table of wares with corresponding amounts)

event_supplies_removed.name: event_supplies_removed
event_supplies_removed.doc: Event for when supply wares were removed from container object (object = container, param = table of wares with corresponding amounts)

event_supply_orders_added.name: event_supply_orders_added
event_supply_orders_added.doc: Event for when supply orders(as wares) were added to container object (object = container, param = table of wares with corresponding amounts)

event_supply_orders_removed.name: event_supply_orders_removed
event_supply_orders_removed.doc: Event for when supply orders(as wares) were removed from container object (object = container, param = table of wares with corresponding amounts)

event_terraforming_event_started.doc: Event for when a terraforming event has started (object = cluster in which terraforming is taking place, param = project ID)

event_terraforming_habitability_changed.name: event_terraforming_habitability_changed
event_terraforming_habitability_changed.doc: Event for when a terraforming world's habitability has changed (object = cluster in which terraforming is taking place)

event_terraforming_project_available.name: event_terraforming_project_available
event_terraforming_project_available.doc: Event for when a repeatable terraforming project has become available again (object = cluster in which terraforming is taking place, param = project ID)

event_terraforming_project_completed.name: event_terraforming_project_completed
event_terraforming_project_completed.doc: Event for when a terraforming project has been completed (object = cluster in which terraforming is taking place, param = project ID)

project.doc: ID of the project that has completed

event_terraforming_project_failed.name: event_terraforming_project_failed
event_terraforming_project_failed.doc: Event for when a terraforming project has been completed unsuccessfully (object = cluster in which terraforming is taking place, param = project ID, param2 = [were there positive side-effects?, were there negative side-effects?])

project.doc: ID of the project that has failed

event_terraforming_project_started.name: event_terraforming_project_started
event_terraforming_project_started.doc: Event for when a terraforming project has started after finishing production - also triggered if the project has no duration and succeeds or fails immediately (object = cluster in which terraforming is taking place, param = project ID)

project.doc: ID of the project that has started

event_terraforming_project_started_produ.name: event_terraforming_project_started_production
event_terraforming_project_started_produ.doc: Event for when a terraforming project has started production - not triggered if the project has no deliveries (object = cluster in which terraforming is taking place, param = project ID)

project.doc: ID of the project that started production

event_terraforming_project_succeeded.name: event_terraforming_project_succeeded
event_terraforming_project_succeeded.doc: Event for when a terraforming project has been completed successfully (object = cluster in which terraforming is taking place, param = project ID, param2 = [were there positive side-effects?, were there negative side-effects?], param3 = payout in Credits)

project.doc: ID of the project that has succeeded

event_terraforming_stat_added.name: event_terraforming_stat_added
event_terraforming_stat_added.doc: Event for when a terraforming stat has been added to the list of relevant stats (object = cluster in which terraforming is taking place, param = stat ID)

stat.doc: ID of the stat that was added

event_terraforming_stat_changed.name: event_terraforming_stat_changed
event_terraforming_stat_changed.doc: Event for when a terraforming stat has changed (object = cluster in which terraforming is taking place, param = stat ID)

stat.doc: ID of the stat that was changed

event_terraforming_stat_removed.name: event_terraforming_stat_removed
event_terraforming_stat_removed.doc: Event for when a terraforming stat has been removed from the list of relevant stats (object = cluster in which terraforming is taking place, param = stat ID)

stat.doc: ID of the stat that was removed

event_trade_cancelled.name: event_trade_cancelled
event_trade_cancelled.doc: Event for when a trade is cancelled, (object = either buyer, seller or space - see following documentation, param = tradeoffer) (If tradeoffer is provided, listened object = tradeoffer owner) : (otherwise buyer and/or seller are preferred where listened object = seller if supplied, otherwise buyer) : (otherwise space must be provided where listened object = space)

space.doc: Space which contains the cancelled trade (can not be used with buyer/seller)

tradeoffer.doc: Trade offer to match. All other attributes and amount check nodes are ignored.

event_trade_completed.name: event_trade_completed
event_trade_completed.doc: Event for when a trade is completed (object = either buyer, seller or space - see following documentation, param = tradeoffer, param2 = tradeorder) (If tradeoffer is provided, listened object = tradeoffer owner) : (otherwise buyer and/or seller are preferred where listened object = seller if supplied, otherwise buyer) : (otherwise space must be provided where listened object = space)

space.doc: Space which contains the completed trade (can not be used with buyer/seller)

tradeoffer.doc: Trade offer to match. All other attributes and amount check nodes are ignored.

event_trade_started.name: event_trade_started
event_trade_started.doc: Event for when a trade is started (object = either buyer or seller - see following documentation, param = tradeoffer, param2 = tradeorder) (If tradeoffer is provided, listened object = tradeoffer owner) : (otherwise buyer and/or seller must be provided, listened object = seller if supplied, otherwise buyer)

tradeoffer.doc: Trade offer to match. All other attributes and amount check nodes are ignored.

event_traffic_level_changed.name: event_traffic_level_changed
event_traffic_level_changed.doc: Event for when the traffic level of an object changes (object = object changing the traffic level, param = new traffic level string, param2 = old traffic level string)

event_ui_triggered.name: event_ui_triggered
event_ui_triggered.doc: Event for when a UI control is triggered (param = screen ID, param2 = control ID, param3 = screen parameters)

event_unit_destroyed.name: event_unit_destroyed
event_unit_destroyed.doc: Event for when a unit has been destroyed (object = the object owning the unit, param = the unit's category, param2 = the unit's mk)

event_venture_mission_completed.doc: Event for a venture mission being completed (param = venture detail list: [mission name, mission type, raw mission name, was mission successful], param2 = list of ships involved, param3 = duration)

event_venture_ship_added.doc: Event for when a venture ship is added to the universe or an existing ship becomes one (param = ship)

event_venture_ship_removed.name: event_venture_ship_removed
event_venture_ship_removed.doc: Event for when a venture ship is removed from the universe or an existing ship is no longer one (param = ship)

event_weapon_ammo_changed.doc: Event for when a weapon has changed its ammo (object = weapon, param = new ammo macro, can be null)

event_weapon_overheated.name: event_weapon_overheated

provideworkforce.doc: Is the providing container allowed to provide people from their own workforce? (defaults to true)

receivepeople.doc: Is the receiving container allowed to receive the people as person templates? Takes precidence over 'receiveworkforce'. Defaults to true.

receiveworkforce.doc: Is the receiving container allowed to receive the people as workforce? (defaults to false)

failed.name: failed
failed.doc: Result values for the cost of people which were unable to be transferred

added.doc: Money value of people who were unable to be added during the transfer

removed.doc: Money value of people who were unable to be removed during the transfer

fillpercent~2.name: fillpercent
fillpercent~2.doc: Maximum cargo space fill percent of the ware(s) added from this ware node. If specified together with fillvalue, the lower amount is used.

fillvalue.name: fillvalue
fillvalue.doc: Maximum credit value of the ware(s) added from this ware node. If specified together with fillpercent, the lower amount is used.

immediate.name: immediate
immediate.doc: Provide the construction sequence immediately. The action will block the game until the result is available.

result.doc: Name of the variable that will receive the resulting construction sequence. In case of failure the result will be null.

interaction~2.name: interaction

inventory.name: inventory
inventory.doc: Inventory the ship is spawned with

level.name: level
level.doc: The percentage level to which this ship should be fitted out with randomly generated equipment. Given as a float between 0 and 1. Note that this level is modified by the variation which defaults to the value from parameters unless explicitly specified as well.

faction.doc: The faction to use for selecting equipment. Has no effect without valid level also specified. (defaults to owner faction)

limits.name: limits
limits.doc: Base station module limits to be respected when initially constructing (Defaults to 20. Modules in defined base construction plans can exceed the limits)

linear.name: linear
linear.doc: Linearly interpolate 'result' within the defined output range, based on the location of the 'value' within the input range

maxinput.doc: Upper end of the input range (must be higher than 'mininput')

maxoutput.doc: Upper end of the output range (may be lower than 'minoutput')

mininput.doc: Lower end of the input range

minoutput.doc: Lower end of the output range (may be higher than 'maxoutput')

linear~2.name: linear
linear~2.doc: The new linear velocity (linear velocity will not be changed if this is omitted)

loadout.name: loadout
loadout.doc: The loadout that the ship should be given. Can be defined as a reference to a loadout definition or as a level to which the ship should be outfitted.

basket.doc: Ware basket containing wares from which the loadout should be generated. If neither basket, wares nor macros are provided, default items for faction will be used.

flags.doc: Loadout flags for elements to apply

loadout.doc: A reference to a loadout created by a script

macros.doc: A list of macros from which the loadout should be generated. Ignored if basket or wares are provided. If neither basket, wares nor macros are provided, default items for faction will be used.

vDoc.8.00: A list of macros from which the loadout should be generated. Ignored if wares are provided. If neither wares nor macros are provided, default items for faction will be used.

purpose.doc: The overriding purpose of the object, considered when generating a loadout (ignored if 'ref' or 'loadout' is defined)

ref.doc: A reference to a loadout definition as defined in loadouts.xml

wares.doc: A list of wares from which the loadout should be generated. Ignored if basket is provided. If neither basket, wares nor macros are provided, default items for faction will be used.

vDoc.8.00: A list of wares from which the loadout should be generated. If neither wares nor macros are provided, default items for faction will be used.

ref.doc: Macro name (either a plain macro string or a script expression that evaluates to a string or macro)

marines.name: marines
marines.doc: Amount of marines by skill level to match against role tiers

amounts.doc: List of amounts (size must match with other lists)

skills.doc: List of skills to help identify people (size must match with other lists)

negate.doc: Negate filter outcome? The negation applies to the whole element, e.g. <match_content negate="true"> matches objects which do NOT have the specified content.

match_all_objects.doc: Check that all objects in the group match the criteria (empty group returns true)

negate.doc: Negate filter outcome? The negation applies to the whole element, e.g. <match_content negate="true"> matches objects which do NOT have the specified content.

negate.doc: Negate filter outcome? The negation applies to the whole element, e.g. <match_content negate="true"> matches objects which do NOT have the specified content.

exact.doc: Exact attention level (not compared if not supplied)

min.doc: Min attention level (not compared if not supplied)

negate.doc: Negate filter outcome? The negation applies to the whole element, e.g. <match_content negate="true"> matches objects which do NOT have the specified content.

match_basket_wares.doc: Match filter for the basket wares of a job ship

match_buyer.name: match_buyer
match_buyer.doc: Match filter for the buyer of the trade

match_buyoffer.name: match_buyoffer
match_buyoffer.doc: Match filter for available buy offers

bundle.doc: Should the ware be bundled (convert ammo/unit -> ware) on transfer?

unbundle.doc: Should the ware be unbundled (turn ware into ammo/units) on transfer?

wares.doc: (optional) single ware or list of wares to filter offers for

match_distance.doc: Match by distance filter. Distance can be checked either to an object or to a position. The reference space, if supplied, must contain the searched objects. min and/or max must be set.

max.doc: Maximal distance (max distance is not compared if not supplied)

min.doc: Minimal distance (min distance is not compared if not supplied)

negate.doc: Negate filter outcome? The negation applies to the whole element, e.g. <match_content negate="true"> matches objects which do NOT have the specified content.

object.doc: Object, used in preference to coordinates if supplied. If no space context is supplied, the object's sector is used, so the searched objects are required to be in the same sector.

space.doc: Reference space which has to contain both the reference (object or position) and the searched objects.

value.doc: Position value, used in preference to coordinates if supplied

match_dock.name: match_dock
match_dock.doc: Match filter for a dock. Can be used on a Module, Container object or a Docking Bay itself. Note: If finding or counting contained components be wary that there may be multiple positive results, even if there is only one dockingbay. e.g. matching contents for a station will include the dockingbay but also its containing module. To only account for docking bays, also filter by dockingbay class.

allowplayeronly.doc: Allow finding a dock that is exclusive for player-controlled ship? (defaults to false, i.e. player-exclusive docks are ignored by default)

building.doc: Is it required that the dock allows building?

hidden.doc: Is the dock flagged as hidden? (defaults to false)

locked.doc: Is the dockingbay locked, e.g. via <set_room_locked>?

negate.doc: Negate filter outcome? The negation applies to the whole element, e.g. <match_content negate="true"> matches objects which do NOT have the specified content.

showroom.doc: Is the dock flagged as a showroom dock? (defaults to false)

size.doc: Dock compatibility size tag or list of size tags (matching 'any').

storage.doc: Is the docking bay an internal storage bay? (defaults to false, i.e. internal storage bays are ignored by default)

trading.doc: Is it required that the dock allows trading?

ventureplatform.doc: Specific venture platform with which venture dock must be associated (optional, can be null). Only takes effect if ventureronly is set to true.

ventureronly.doc: Is dock exclusive for venturers? Can be used in combination with ventureplatform attribute. (Defaults to false, i.e. venturer-exclusive docks are ignored by default)

walkable.doc: Is the dockingbay walkable, i.e. accessible to the player and NPCs?

match_engine_mod.name: match_engine_mod
match_engine_mod.doc: Match filter for engine mods installed on objects (e.g. Ships, Stations)

ware.doc: Engine mod ware (from equipmentmods.xml, defines a quality level and primary property of engine mod, any if not specified)

match_gate_distance.name: match_gate_distance
match_gate_distance.doc: Match by distance by jumpgates. Calculation based on the sectors of the objects. Checking distance of clusters will check between two random sectors within them.

max.doc: Max distance by jumpgates (not compared if not supplied)

min.doc: Min distance by jumpgates (not compared if not supplied)

negate.doc: Negate filter outcome? The negation applies to the whole element, e.g. <match_content negate="true"> matches objects which do NOT have the specified content.

object.doc: Origin object for the distance calculation. Passing cluster will base the check on a random sector.

match_has_view_of.name: match_has_view_of
match_has_view_of.doc: Match whether the searched object has the provided location in view, within the specified view angles. The reference location that must be in view of the searched object can be specified either via an object or via a position. The reference space, if supplied, must contain the searched objects.

horizontal.doc: The horizontal viewing angle (full range from left to right)

negate.doc: Negate filter outcome? The negation applies to the whole element, e.g. <match_content negate="true"> matches objects which do NOT have the specified content.

object.doc: Object, used in preference to coordinates if supplied. If no space context is supplied, the object's sector is used, so the searched objects are required to be in the same sector.

space.doc: Reference space which has to contain both the reference (object or position) and the searched objects.

vertical.doc: The vertical viewing angle (full range from top to bottom)

timer.doc: Optional timer value to request an <event_speak_timer_triggered> event at a certain time while a speak voice sample is played: Specify either a value of type time as an absolute real-time offset (e.g. 500ms to trigger the event after half a second), or a value of type float, relative to the duration of the speak (e.g. 0.5 to trigger the event after 50 percent of the speak duration). A negative value of either type is interpreted as the time before the end of the speak (e.g. -500ms to trigger half a second before the speak ends). The timer event is guaranteed to be triggered before <event_speak_finished>. If the speak fails or gets interrupted for any reason (possibly even before the requested time), both <event_speak_timer_triggered> and <event_speak_finished> will be triggered in this order, each with param3 indicating the failure reason. The event timing accuracy is about 50ms. It is not possible to trigger more than one timer event per speak. See also attribute interruptontimer.
